experiences.title: CEO & Co-founder
experiences.description:
Canva is a simple-to-use online design and publishing platform that allows everyone to create professional quality designs. With over 15 million users from 190 countries Canva has been growing rapidly since its launch in August 2012, however we're just getting started!

For more info see: www.canva.com

experiences.title: Founder and Director
experiences.description:
Fusion Books is an innovative online publishing system which enables people to create stylish and professional yearbooks quickly and easily even if they have had no publishing experience. 

The entire school, club or business can jump online and design photo pages, article pages and add their own profile. The yearbooks are then printed into a high-quality production which can be kept for generations as a special memento.

experiences.title: Multimedia Centre Technical Assistant and Tutor
experiences.description: Providing technical support and tuition to students, using software such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Flash and iMovie.

instagram.biography: Co-founder and CEO of @Canva. Working with an incredible team to empower the world to design.

recentPosts.caption: Meet Pumba - he is my little bros incredibly adorable rescue pup who was a little too scared to cross the road this morning.

As Canva has grown *everything* has had to change and evolve too. On people’s birthday we have always tried to do something a little special, people could choose a birthday meal that our amazing Vibe team would create - we now have more birthdays than work days in the year so had to iterate, here’s their latest creation, The Birthday Wheel. Our team is the best 😂

First of Jan in Rio and my first insta post ☺️ Love getting away each year and getting to know a little more of this big, beautiful, chaotic, crazy world we live in. Always leave with a few life lessons and Brazil has certainly not disappointed.
